preconditions.description: The number of balls is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of swaps is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The initial position of the special ball is between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= x_i, y_i <= n and x_i != y_i
preconditions.description: Each swap involves two distinct positions between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of n integers
postconditions.description: The output is a list of integers, each representing the minimum number of swaps Masha has to fake to place the special ball on the i-th position.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == -1 if the special ball cannot be placed on the i-th position
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to place the special ball on the i-th position, the output for that position should be -1.
